visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-screen "Choose your AMAG garage" modal: headline, search field and a filterable garage link list
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-screen garage chooser modal: headline, a search field that filters the list by text, and one link per garage (name, street, place). Opens from any `a[href$="#garage-chooser"]` on the page (e.g. the cta-band CTA), with a 300ms dialog transition; closes on the close controls, Escape and a backdrop click. Renders fixed - takes no flow height

contentPattern.structure:
One row per garage; a leading row with a heading and no link is the chooser headline. Garage rows read by role: the link-bearing `

` is the garage name and the whole row links to its href (inner anchor unwrapped); the remaining `

`s are the street and the place
